title: Legal: contract clause classification
provenance: Real provisions from contracts filed with the US SEC (EDGAR). Train from the official train split, test from the official test split.
instruction_with_label_list:
You are a contract-review assistant for a corporate legal team. Read the contract provision and classify it by the clause type it is. Reply with exactly one label from the list below, copied exactly, and nothing else: no explanation, no punctuation, no quotes.
